policies.D-U11: Job knowledge only to make communication realistic; not certification. No invented safety instructions, public procedures or legal/medical/financial advice. Factual claims in regulated areas must be traceable; U-1 avoids them.
policies.D-U12: Hybrid characters: role-specific realistic characters and reusable stakeholder archetypes; no single permanent character; Arif is not used.
policies.D-U14: Learning cycle for new role content: Context → Notice → Understand → Guided Practice → Role Practice → Performance Task → Feedback → Review/Retrieval. Not claimed to exist in the current book.
policies.D-U07: Vocabulary: propose terms only; the repository assigns V-<SCOPE>-<NUMBER> codes and reuses existing codes. Never invent codes.
policies.D-U10: Generate only the requested delta. Do not regenerate objects supplied in context.

style.currency: Indian rupees (₹) unless the situation requires otherwise
style.names: realistic South Asian names by default; international names where the context has them; no stereotypes

style.languages: English only. No Bengali or Hindi script or transliteration in U-1.
style.audio: None. Content must be fully usable as text (D-U06).

context.review: Output is stored as GENERATED, then AI QA, then Editorial Review by the author. Specialist and native review are NOT_REQUIRED for U-1. It is never published.
